title: Field complex homotopy normal form
statement: theorem homotopyEquiv_of_single_field_homology {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (hR : IsField R) (P : CochainComplex (Spec R).Modules ℤ) (i r : ℕ) (hzero : ∀ q : ℕ, q ≠ i → IsZero (P.homology q)) (hrank : (P.homology i).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r) : Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv P ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (Spec R).Modules (i : ℤ)).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec R).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))))

proof.text: Construct the stated homotopy equivalence by splitting the bounded complex into contractible boundary summands and its sole cohomology summand over a field.

mathlib_searches.query: derived fibre of a bounded finite free complex with single locally free cohomology is homotopy equivalent to a single vector space
finite free cochain complex local homotopy equivalence single complex residue cohomology
